method.title: 方法
method.body: 先记录并排除原式不允许的输入，再化简。约分后仍保留原排除点；只有化简式在该点具有有限值时才是空洞。若仍有不可约分母零点，须另判该点附近的渐近线等行为。

method.title: Method
method.body: Record and exclude inputs forbidden by the original functions before simplifying. Keep those exclusions after cancellation. An excluded input produces a hole only when the reduced formula has a finite value there. If an uncancelled denominator still vanishes, examine the nearby behaviour separately, including possible vertical asymptotes.

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. Let $f(x)=(x+3)^2$ and $g(x)=x+4$. Which represents $h(x)=f(x)+g(x)$? A $x^2+7x+7$; B $x^2+7x+13$; C $x^2+x+13$; D $x^2+2x+7$.

exercises.prompt: 若 $f(x)=x+8$、$g(x)=2x^2-128$，$y=g(x)/f(x)$ 的定义域是什么？A $\{x\mid x\in\mathbb R\}$；B $\{x\mid x\in\mathbb I\}$；C $\{x\mid x\ne8,x\in\mathbb R\}$；D $\{x\mid x\ne-8,x\in\mathbb R\}$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 原分母 $x+8\ne0$，所以 $x\ne-8$。即使化简为 $2(x-8)$，这个原限制仍保留，选择 D。

en.prompt: If $f(x)=x+8$ and $g(x)=2x^2-128$, what is the domain of $y=g(x)/f(x)$? A $\{x\mid x\in\mathbb R\}$; B $\{x\mid x\in\mathbb I\}$; C $\{x\mid x\ne8,x\in\mathbb R\}$; D $\{x\mid x\ne-8,x\in\mathbb R\}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The original denominator requires $x+8\ne0$, hence $x\ne-8$. Simplifying to $2(x-8)$ does not remove that restriction. Choose D.

exercises.prompt: 原图给出两个函数。对 $x\in\mathbb R$，哪项为真？A $g(x)-f(x)<0$；B $f(x)/g(x)>1,x\ne0$；C $f(x)<g(x)$；D $g(x)+f(x)<0$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: B 在 $x=-1$ 时商为 $-3$，不成立；C 与已证不等式相反；D 在 $x=0$ 时和为 $2>0$。

en.prompt: The graphs of two functions are shown. Which is true for $x\in\mathbb R$? A $g(x)-f(x)<0$; B $f(x)/g(x)>1,x\ne0$; C $f(x)<g(x)$; D $g(x)+f(x)<0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The graph gives $f(x)=x^2+2$ and $g(x)=x$. Then $g-f=-x^2+x-2=-(x-1/2)^2-7/4<0$ for every real input, so A.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: B fails at $x=-1$, where the quotient is $-3$; C contradicts the proved inequality; D fails at $x=0$, where the sum is $2>0$.

en.prompt: Given $f(x)=5-x$ and $g(x)=2\sqrt{3x}$, what is $f(g(3))$? A $5-2\sqrt6$; B $2\sqrt{15-3x^2}$; C $-1$; D $1$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 把内函数 $x^2$ 代入 $f$ 的输入，得到 $f(g(x))=x^2+5$，选 A。

en.prompt: Which function represents $y=f(g(x))$ if $f(x)=x+5$ and $g(x)=x^2$? A $y=x^2+5$; B $y=x^2+25$; C $y=x^2+x+5$; D $y=x^2+10x+25$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Substitute the inner expression $x^2$ into $f$: $f(g(x))=x^2+5$. Choose A.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) $h=\sin x+2x^2$；b) $h=\sin x-2x^2$；c) $h=2x^2\sin x$。三个定义域均为 $\mathbb R$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: d) $h=\sin x/(2x^2)$，原分母要求 $2x^2\ne0$，所以 $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$。

en.prompt: Given $f(x)=\sin x$ and $g(x)=2x^2$, determine a) $h=(f+g)(x)$; b) $h=(f-g)(x)$; c) $h=(f\cdot g)(x)$; d) $h=(f/g)(x)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $h=\sin x+2x^2$; b) $h=\sin x-2x^2$; c) $h=2x^2\sin x$. All three domains are $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: d) $h=\sin x/(2x^2)$; $2x^2\ne0$ requires $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$.

en.answer: a) $\sin x+2x^2$; b) $\sin x-2x^2$; c) $2x^2\sin x$; d) $\sin x/(2x^2),x\ne0$.

exercises.prompt: 抄写并补全表格的缺项。列为 $g(x),f(x),(f+g)(x),(f\circ g)(x)$。a) 已知 $g=x-8,f=\sqrt{x}$；b) 已知 $g=x+3,f=4x$；c) 已知 $f=\sqrt{x-4},(f\circ g)(x)=\sqrt{x^2-4}$；d) 已知 $g=1/x,(f\circ g)(x)=x$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) 和 $x-8+\sqrt{x}$，$D=[0,\infty)$；复合 $\sqrt{x-8}$，$D=[8,\infty)$。b) 和 $5x+3$；复合 $4x+12$；定义域均为 $\mathbb R$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: c) 常规的多项式选择为 $g(x)=x^2$，和为 $x^2+\sqrt{x-4}$（$x\ge4$）；复合为 $\sqrt{x^2-4}$（$x\le-2$ 或 $x\ge2$）。严格地说，只给复合的实数函数值，并未唯一指定 $(-2,2)$ 内的 $g$；表中填的是最简单的代数选择。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: d) 取 $f(x)=1/x$，则和 $2/x$，定义域 $x\ne0$；$f(1/x)=1/(1/x)=x$，但复合仍只在 $x\ne0$ 成立。复合条件也不决定 $f(0)$；标准倒数函数在该点未定义。

en.prompt: Copy and complete the missing entries in the table with columns $g(x),f(x),(f+g)(x),(f\circ g)(x)$. a) $g=x-8,f=\sqrt{x}$; b) $g=x+3,f=4x$; c) $f=\sqrt{x-4},(f\circ g)(x)=\sqrt{x^2-4}$; d) $g=1/x,(f\circ g)(x)=x$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) Sum $x-8+\sqrt{x}$, $D=[0,\infty)$; composition $\sqrt{x-8}$, $D=[8,\infty)$. b) Sum $5x+3$; composition $4x+12$; both domains are $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: c) The conventional polynomial choice is $g(x)=x^2$. The sum is $x^2+\sqrt{x-4}$ for $x\ge4$; composition is $\sqrt{x^2-4}$ for $x\le-2$ or $x\ge2$. Strictly, real values of the composite do not uniquely specify $g$ on $(-2,2)$; this is the simplest algebraic choice.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: d) Choose $f(x)=1/x$. The sum is $2/x$, $x\ne0$; $f(1/x)=1/(1/x)=x$, still only for $x\ne0$. The composition does not determine $f(0)$; the standard reciprocal function is undefined there.

en.answer: a) $x-8+\sqrt{x}$, $\sqrt{x-8}$; b) $5x+3$, $4x+12$; c) conventional $g=x^2$, sum $x^2+\sqrt{x-4}$; d) conventional $f=1/x$, sum $2/x$. Restrictions are in the steps.

exercises.prompt: 求 $g(x)=1/(1+x)$ 和 $h(x)=1/(3+2x)$ 的积，然后写组合函数的定义域。

en.prompt: Determine the product of $g(x)=1/(1+x)$ and $h(x)=1/(3+2x)$, then state its domain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $gh=1/[(1+x)(3+2x)]=1/(2x^2+5x+3)$. The original denominators require $x\ne-1$ and $x\ne-3/2$, both retained.

exercises.prompt: 用原图的 $f(x)$、$g(x)$ 画各组合函数：a) $y=(f-g)(x)$；b) $y=(f/g)(x)$。

en.prompt: Use the original graphs of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ to sketch a) $y=(f-g)(x)$; b) $y=(f/g)(x)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The vertex $(1,9)$ and zeros $-2,4$ give $f(x)=-(x-1)^2+9=-x^2+2x+8$; the line is $g(x)=x+2$. a) Difference $-x^2+x+6=-(x-1/2)^2+25/4$, vertex $(1/2,25/4)$ and zeros $-2,3$. $D=\mathbb R$, $R=(-\infty,25/4]$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b) $[-(x-4)(x+2)]/(x+2)=4-x$, retaining $x\ne-2$. Draw the line with slope $-1$ and intercept $4$, with hole $(-2,6)$; $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{6\}$.

exercises.prompt: 对每对函数，求 $g(f(x))$ 并写定义域和值域。a) $f(x)=3-x,g(x)=|x+3|$；b) $f(x)=4^x,g(x)=x+1$；c) $f(x)=x^4,g(x)=\sqrt{x}$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: c) $g(f(x))=\sqrt{x^4}=|x^2|=x^2$。内函数 $x^4\ge0$ 总能输入根函数，所以 $D=\mathbb R$，$R=[0,\infty)$。

en.prompt: For each pair, determine $g(f(x))$ and state its domain and range. a) $f(x)=3-x,g(x)=|x+3|$; b) $f(x)=4^x,g(x)=x+1$; c) $f(x)=x^4,g(x)=\sqrt{x}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $g(f(x))=|3-x+3|=|6-x|$, $D=\mathbb R$, $R=[0,\infty)$, minimum at $(6,0)$. b) $g(f(x))=4^x+1$, $D=\mathbb R$; since $4^x>0$, $R=(1,\infty)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: c) $g(f(x))=\sqrt{x^4}=|x^2|=x^2$. Since $x^4\ge0$ for every real $x$, $D=\mathbb R$, $R=[0,\infty)$.

en.answer: a) $|6-x|$, $D=\mathbb R,R=[0,\infty)$; b) $4^x+1$, $D=\mathbb R,R=(1,\infty)$; c) $x^2$, $D=\mathbb R,R=[0,\infty)$.

exercises.prompt: Becky 每份工资扣 200 元退休金，可在联邦所得税之前或之后扣；税率 28%。a) 以每期工资 $x$ 表示扣退休金后的收入 $r$ 和税后收入 $t$。b) 求并解释 $t(r(x))$。c) 每期 2700 元时，用 b) 求净收入。d) 用 $r(t(x))$ 求净收入。e) 解释差额。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: e) 税前扣款使应税额少 200 元，少交税 $0.28(200)=56$ 元，故净收入多 56 元。按本题固定税率模型，税前扣款要 $x\ge200$，若税后净额不为负，则另一顺序要 $x\ge200/0.72$。

en.prompt: Becky has 200 dollars deducted from every paycheque for retirement, either before or after federal income tax is assessed. Her federal tax rate is 28%. a) Let $x$ be earnings per pay period; represent income $r$ after retirement and income $t$ after federal taxes. b) Determine and interpret $t(r(x))$. c) For earnings of 2700 dollars, calculate net income using b). d) Calculate net income using $r(t(x))$. e) Explain the difference.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $r(x)=x-200$, $t(x)=0.72x$. b) $t(r(x))=0.72(x-200)=0.72x-144$, deducting retirement before taxing the remainder.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: e) Deducting before tax reduces taxable earnings by 200 dollars and tax by $0.28(200)=56$ dollars, increasing net income by 56 dollars. In this fixed-rate model, the first order needs $x\ge200$; nonnegative after-tax net income in the other order needs $x\ge200/0.72$.

en.answer: a) $r=x-200,t=0.72x$; b) $0.72x-144$; c) 1800 dollars; d) 1744 dollars; e) 56 dollars more remains with the pre-tax deduction.

exercises.prompt: 钟摆释放后按照 $x(t)=(10\cos2t)(0.95^t)$ 往复摆动，$x$ 为离静止位置的水平位移（厘米），$t$ 为时间（秒）。a) 画函数图像。b) 此式是两函数之积。指出各函数，并说明哪一个负责 i) 周期运动；ii) 振幅的指数衰减。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) 采用弧度制、$t\ge0$。图从 $(0,10)$ 开始，在包络 $x=\pm10(0.95)^t$ 内振荡；零点 $t=\pi/4+k\pi/2$（非负整数 $k$），余弦周期为 $\pi$ 秒。完整乘积因振幅减小并非周期函数。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: b-i) $f(t)=10\cos2t$ 负责往复运动，角频率 $2$ 弧度/秒。b-ii) $g(t)=0.95^t$ 每秒乘 $0.95$，因此振幅每秒降低 5%，包络为 $10(0.95)^t$ 厘米。

exercises.answer: 图如解析；周期因子 $10\cos2t$，衰减因子 $0.95^t$。

en.prompt: A pendulum is released and swings according to $x(t)=(10\cos2t)(0.95^t)$, where $x$ is horizontal displacement from rest in centimetres and $t$ is time in seconds. a) Graph the function. b) Identify the two factors and explain which is responsible for i) periodic motion; ii) exponential decay of amplitude.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) Use radians and $t\ge0$. The graph starts at $(0,10)$ and oscillates inside $x=\pm10(0.95)^t$. Zeros occur at $t=\pi/4+k\pi/2$ for nonnegative integers $k$; the cosine factor has period $\pi$ seconds. The full product is not periodic because its amplitude decreases.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b-i) $f(t)=10\cos2t$ produces the oscillation, with angular frequency $2$ radians per second. b-ii) $g(t)=0.95^t$ multiplies amplitude by $0.95$ each second, a 5% decrease per second; the amplitude envelope is $10(0.95)^t$ cm.

en.answer: See the graph; $10\cos2t$ causes oscillation and $0.95^t$ causes exponential amplitude decay.

exercises.prompt: 给定 $f(x)=2x^2+11x-21$、$g(x)=2x-3$，求方程并画各组合函数草图：a) $y=f(x)-g(x)$；b) $y=f(x)+g(x)$；c) $y=f(x)/g(x)$；d) $y=f(g(x))$。

en.prompt: Given $f(x)=2x^2+11x-21$ and $g(x)=2x-3$, determine the equation and sketch each combined function: a) $y=f(x)-g(x)$; b) $y=f(x)+g(x)$; c) $y=f(x)/g(x)$; d) $y=f(g(x))$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: c) $f(x)=(2x-3)(x+7)$, so the quotient is $x+7$, retaining $x\ne3/2$. Hole $(3/2,17/2)$; $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{17/2\}$.

exercises.prompt: 石头落入湖面，产生以 $50\text{ cm/s}$ 向外传播的圆形波纹。a) 写圆面积关于时间的函数，说明组合函数类型。b) 画图。c) 5 秒后的面积是多少？d) 计算 30 秒后的面积是否合理？解释。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) 半径 $r(t)=50t$ 厘米，面积函数 $A(r)=\pi r^2$，复合得 $A(t)=A(r(t))=2500\pi t^2$ 平方厘米，$t\ge0$。b) 画第一象限向上抛物线，经过 $(0,0)$、$(1,2500\pi)$、$(5,62500\pi)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: c) $A(5)=2500\pi(25)=62500\pi$ 平方厘米 $=6.25\pi$ 平方米，约 $19.635$ 平方米。d) 理想模型给 $r(30)=1500$ 厘米 $=15$ 米，$A(30)=225\pi$ 平方米；只有波纹保持可辨、以恒速传播且未遇岸边或障碍时才适用。原题没有这些资料，不能肯定 30 秒仍合理。

exercises.answer: $A(t)=2500\pi t^2$ 平方厘米；5 秒为 $62500\pi$ 平方厘米；30 秒结果有条件。

en.prompt: A stone dropped into a lake creates a circular ripple travelling outward at $50\text{ cm/s}$. a) Write area as a function of time and state the type of combined function. b) Graph it. c) Find the area after 5 s. d) Is it reasonable to calculate the area after 30 s? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) Radius $r(t)=50t$ cm and area $A(r)=\pi r^2$ give the composite $A(t)=A(r(t))=2500\pi t^2$ cm² for $t\ge0$. b) Draw the first-quadrant upward parabola through $(0,0)$, $(1,2500\pi)$, and $(5,62500\pi)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: c) $A(5)=2500\pi(25)=62500\pi$ cm² $=6.25\pi$ m², about $19.635$ m². d) The ideal model gives $r(30)=1500$ cm $=15$ m and $A(30)=225\pi$ m². This is meaningful only if the ripple remains discernible, keeps its speed, and has not met a shore or obstacle. The question gives no evidence guaranteeing those conditions at 30 s.

en.answer: $A(t)=2500\pi t^2$ cm²; after 5 s, $62500\pi$ cm²; the 30-second result is conditional.
